d:
Immerse yourself in the mesmerizing artistry of Ustad Vilayat Khan, one of the greatest sitar maestros of all time. In this exquisite performance, he explores Vilambita Laya (slow tempo) in Tin Tala, showcasing the graceful Barhat Anga (progressive development of the raga).
Credits:
Song: Vilambita Laya - Tin Tala Barhat Anga
Artist: Ustad Vilayat Khan
Music Director: Traditional
Lyricist: Traditional
Label- Saregama India Limited, A RPSG Group Company
